The '''Patriim system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hockaleg]]. The system was the construction site of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Tarkin (superweapon)|''Tarkin'']] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].
